description: Returns the private foundations that have given to recipients in a cause area, optionally in one state, from filed 990-PF returns. The cause area is the IRS NTEE major group of the recipient organization, so the list shows where a funder has given, not what it says it funds. This is a record of past giving, not an open call. Inputs: cause, and optional state, page and limit. Causes: Arts and culture (A), Education (B), Environment (C), Animals (D), Health care (E), Mental health and crisis (F), Disease and disorders (G), Medical research (H), Crime and legal aid (I), Employment (J), Food and agriculture (K), Housing and shelter (L), Public safety and disaster relief (M), Recreation and sports (N), Youth development (O), Human services (P), International affairs (Q), Civil rights and advocacy (R), Community improvement (S), Philanthropy and grantmaking (T), Science and technology (U), Social science (V), Public and societal benefit (W), Religion (X), Mutual benefit (Y), Unclassified (Z). Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

cause.description: Cause area name (for example "Education") or its NTEE major group letter (for example "B").

state.description: Optional 2-letter state code of the recipient organizations, not of the funder.

name: funders_for_cause
title: Find Funders By Cause Area
